description: Minimal capability for the main window. The app UI is served by the local backend over http; almost no Tauri IPC is used from the frontend - the exceptions are the custom title bar (frontend/modules/window-controls.js), which needs window minimize/maximize/close/drag, and a handful of the app's own commands (close_to_tray, exit_app, manual_check_for_updates). The 'remote' block extends this capability to that http origin, since it's otherwise only granted to the bundled tauri:// asset content (the ui-shell splash page) - and because the origin is remote, Tauri enforces ACL on every invoke() including the app's own bare commands, not just plugin ones, hence the allow-* entries below (autogenerated by build.rs's app_manifest().commands() call).
